_about: cheribsd-subobject arm (CHERI clang -Xclang -cheri-bounds=subobject-safe), pre-registered. CHERI treats only size-0/1 trailing arrays as flexible, so 04 and 06 -- trailing arrays Capstone's C1 v1 refuses -- ARE narrowed here. In subobject-safe mode &array[n] gets the WHOLE field's bounds, which still stops a crossing into the next field. Medium confidence on 00-03: they subscript the member directly (s->f[i] = v), so the narrowing must come from array-to-pointer decay; that is the open question this arm answers. 09 is pointer arithmetic inside one int array: no field.
